target_note: At least five scores >=90 in this single six-world batch; no rounding or best-of-run selection. Target confirmation also requires a clean audit, complete token usage and six timely submissions. This is a user baseline target, not an official contest pass threshold.
source_note: Compares current on-disk source with the run manifest; cannot prove historical file immutability.

timing.note: Total excludes queue; exploration includes final sealing and bookkeeping. Deadline compliance uses the timely pair, not total or finalization time. Unattributed time may include interrupted tools; it is not measured Python overhead.

model.ttft_note: Per-call first-token timestamps are not logged; no TTFT or prefill time is inferred.

tools.note: Interrupted tools may have no tools.jsonl completion row; their duration is not invented.

noise.noise_note: Independent Gaussian position and probe-velocity noise on each new measurement when noise is enabled; cached records are immutable. Controlled initial states are exact.
noise.note: Measured t0 readings are compared with exact launch controls, without loading hidden truth. Nonzero residuals corroborate noisy readouts; this small sample does not establish a Gaussian distribution.
